description_for_human: Explainable model signals and research data for US stocks. Read-only.
description_for_model: fAlpha research tools for US-listed stocks. Use them when the person asks what the model says about a stock, what drives a reading, how two stocks compare, when a signal changed direction, how a stock or its signal performed over a past range, which covered stocks rank highest on the signal, or for news sentiment, analyst coverage, SEC filings, reported fundamentals and the US macro backdrop. All tools are read-only. Results are model output and they are never investment advice.
